{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Brintooin itself is a world of plains, deserts, marshes, scrub, scattered woods, and other flatlands&mdash;ideal terrain for armored combat (the reason it was selected as the baseworld for the Hammers).|Special unit threat assessment report by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Captain [[Zgorth'sth]]|<ref name="SMUIU">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>}}
[[File:GolrathStation.png|thumb|right|200px|Golrath served as a Rebel Alliance baseworld.]]
A '''baseworld''', alternatively spelled as '''base world''', was a term used to refer to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]]<ref name="Beheboth">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040617beheboth3|series=Beheboth: Blood and Water|text=Part 3: The Tirrith Trap}}</ref> and [[Brintooin]].<ref name="SMUIU" />
